cues.en: Let's proceed.
cues.zh: 繼續。

cues.en: Now we can add our newly created route to the Main.py file.
cues.zh: 現在把新建立的路由加入 main.py。

cues.en: So you're going to open Main.py file within backend app API.
cues.zh: 開啟 backend/app/api 裡的 main.py。

cues.en: Then as usual at the top from the profile routes, we're also going to bring in dummy route.
cues.zh: 一樣在上面從 profile 路由匯入 me 路由。

cues.en: Then scroll to the bottom duplicate that route.
cues.zh: 捲動到下面，複製這條路由。

cues.en: Now this changes from upload to Traotor to me dot router.
cues.zh: 將 upload.router 改為 me.router。

cues.en: Then you can save the file and then back on postman.
cues.zh: 儲存檔案，再回到 Postman。

cues.en: Please make sure you're still logged in.
cues.zh: 請確認你仍處於登入狀態。

cues.en: So since I logged in yesterday and my refresh token expires after a day, I think I can hit my refresh route and still get new access tokens because my refresh token still hasn't expired.
cues.zh: 我昨天登入，而更新權杖一天後到期，所以應該還能呼叫 refresh 路由取得新的存取權杖，因為更新權杖尚未到期。

cues.en: But remember, the access tokens expire after a very short time, which in our case is around 15 minutes.
cues.zh: 記得存取權杖很快就會到期，在本例約為 15 分鐘。

cues.en: So after logging in again, we're now going to make a Get request to http api dot localhost, then slash api slash v1 slash profile slash me.
cues.zh: 重新登入後，對 http://api.localhost/api/v1/profile/me 發送 GET 請求。

cues.en: So you can make request good.
cues.zh: 送出請求，很好。

cues.en: Then in the body you're going to get a 200 okay status code.
cues.zh: 會收到 200 OK 狀態碼。

cues.en: Then in the response body you're going to get all the fields that were specified.
cues.zh: 回應本文中會有指定的所有欄位。

cues.en: That is the username first name and all this.
cues.zh: 也就是 username、first_name 等這些欄位。

cues.en: Then since we have the bidirectional relationship between the user and the profile model, we can also get the profile fields which are all these.
cues.zh: 由於 User 與 Profile 模型有雙向關聯，也能取得所有這些 Profile 欄位。

cues.en: Then remember these other fields at the top.
cues.zh: 記得上面這些欄位。

cues.en: These are the user related fields.
cues.zh: 是與 User 有關的欄位。

cues.en: Then the profile related fields are all here up to and including the profile photo, URL, ID, photo URL, and the signature of photo URL.
cues.zh: 下面則是 Profile 相關欄位，包含 profile_photo_url、id_photo_url 與 signature_photo_url。

cues.en: So it seems everything is working as expected.
cues.zh: 看來一切都如預期運作。

cues.en: So what you're going to do is we're going to go back to VSCode, then we can commit our code.
cues.zh: 回到 VS Code，提交程式碼。

cues.en: So this is a feature.
cues.zh: 這是一項 feature。

cues.en: And you're going to say user can get their profile information just like that.
cues.zh: 訊息寫「使用者可以取得自己的個人資料資訊」。

cues.en: Then you can make the commit good.
cues.zh: 接著提交，很好。

cues.en: That's it for this lecture.
cues.zh: 這堂課就到這裡。

cues.en: In the next lecture we're going to be working on the profile pagination.
cues.zh: 下一堂處理個人資料分頁。
